recommendedBy: session agent, working one component at a time

items.why: Next pass is Input, which carries CUI-039 and the placeholder bullet of CUI-044 with it.
Skeleton sends a consumer to the wrong stylesheet, which is CUI-006's failure with a documented cause.
A silent unstyled render is a bad failure mode for a design system, and one app shipped that way unnoticed.
A documented accessibility escalation that does nothing, and a test that cannot catch it.
Reduced motion silently breaks any consumer chaining messages off onDone.
A minimap that mounts before its content draws nothing, ever.
A section the gate has never once photographed.
